question: Disentangle failure to have any measurable source tag by forecast cutoff from availability of source tags that do not distinguish the chosen future target.
scientific_role: A post-exposure forensic decomposition of an already evaluated 18,432-row synthetic result; NOT a new held-out validation, prospective protocol or causal ecological finding.

fixed_diagnostic_rules.isolate_target_ambiguity: Only score evidence opportunity versus target diagnosticity among rows with target_ambiguous_from_cutoff_occupancy==True; keep all 18,432 raw rows and count the target-known remainder
fixed_diagnostic_rules.available_at_cutoff: mean_cutoff_occupied_selected_sites > 1e-9; this is nonzero EXPECTED occupancy of at least one selected site over latent 3-history prior, not actual observation of a tag
fixed_diagnostic_rules.informative_for_target: added_source_information_bits > 1e-9 under original v44 q=0.60/e=0.10 noisy tag likelihood, conditional on cutoff occupancy
fixed_diagnostic_rules.diagnostic_fraction: count target-uncertain informative rows / count target-uncertain rows with nonzero expected available site; null if no available rows
fixed_diagnostic_rules.opportunity_rate: count target-uncertain rows with nonzero expected occupied selected site / count target-uncertain rows
fixed_diagnostic_rules.gross_information_bits: arithmetic mean original v44 conditional MI on all target-uncertain design rows; no new fit
fixed_diagnostic_rules.conditional_info_on_available: arithmetic mean original v44 conditional MI only over the target-uncertain designs with >0 expected observable sites; not per field sample
fixed_diagnostic_rules.geometry_and_policy: report every original panel×target×policy×geometry stratum, and geometry pooled with same fixed denominators
